title: The Totals row's Margin % stays the true total and can go below zero
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two tracked parts for this test: part A at a cost of $10.00 and a Sell Price of $20.00 with 3 in its bin, and part B at a cost of $5.00 and a Sell Price of $40.00 with 0 in its bin.
  • Add 1 of part B to a work order line while its bin holds 0, so part B's bin goes to -1.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory Value report (Reports in the top bar, then Inventory Value), with the as-of date on today.
custom_steps:
1. Pick the test location only in the Location filter.
  2. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the report's Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The report shows the test location only.

Step 2:

  • Part A's row reads Qty 3.00, Total Cost $30.00, Total Sell $60.00, Margin $30.00 and Margin % 50.0% ($30.00 ÷ $60.00).
  • Part B's row reads Qty -1.00, Total Cost -$5.00, Total Sell -$40.00 and Margin -$35.00 (-$40.00 − (-$5.00)), and its Margin % shows the dash "—".
  • The Totals row reads Qty 2.00 (3 + (-1)), Total Cost $25.00 ($30.00 + (-$5.00)), Total Sell $20.00 ($60.00 + (-$40.00)) and Margin -$5.00 ($30.00 + (-$35.00)).
  • The Totals row's Margin % reads -25.0% (-$5.00 ÷ $20.00 × 100): a value below zero, not a dash and not part A's 50.0%.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; ships with this epic)

  • Feature Overview, Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10380, comment, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “The footer Margin % stays the true aggregate (total margin divided by total sell), even when that goes above 100% or below 0. A single negative row keeps showing the dash, as today.”
  • SV-10380, comment, Nemanja Djuric, 23 Oct 2026: “Inventory Value now uses the net of all bins, so a part below zero shows a negative quantity, cost and sell value. On a single row that's fine: a negative row's Margin % shows "—", as it does today. The footer, however, is total margin ÷ total sell, and with mixed signs it can go above 100%.”
  • SV-10380, description, Expected behavior: “Use the net sum of all bin quantities, including negatives, for Inventory Value report quantities and valuation. Include negative-quantity parts with their signed values. A net-zero part contributes zero; this bug does not mandate displaying a zero-quantity row.”
